newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica Stals unlikely to stay beyond 1999 - Manuel.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica Stals unlikely to stay beyond 1999 - Manuel.

text.p: South African central Reserve Bank Governor Chris Stals is unlikely to stay in office after his current term expires in 1999, Finance Minister Trevor Manuel said in an interview published on Thursday.

"He's not raised the issue. I think that apart from other things he is post retirement age. He joined the Reserve Bank in 1954. That's a long time. So he has had an innings," Manuel told Business Report.
Manuel said he had a close working relationship with the central bank head, although this did not mean the two agreed all the time.
He said he would like South Africa eventually to follow the British example whereby discussions between the finance minister and the governor became public after a certain time.

"I would like to get to the point that you have in a number of countries where we have our regular meetings and that the minutes of that meeting sometime after become a matter of public record," he said.
